title: devkb counts a recursive function as its own caller
body:
**What I did:** I asked devkb about a helper that nothing calls any more, except itself (it is recursive), because I wanted to delete it.

**What I got:** `devkb symbol` says it has 1 caller, and the refactor pack lists the helper's own file as a file with a caller, so it looks used.

**What I expected:** a function that only calls itself has no callers; one that is also called elsewhere counts only those other callers, in every place devkb reports callers.
